description: Claude Code Observability Dashboard - Monitor usage, costs, and performance

panels.title: 🚀 Max Plan Leverage  (your data is ~$0 marginal under Max, so cost = leverage extracted)

panels.description: Equivalent API value extracted divided by the prorated cost of your flat Max plan over the selected range. Higher = more compute leverage per subscription dollar.
panels.title: Leverage (× plan)

panels.description: What this usage would have cost at pay-as-you-go API prices over the selected range.
panels.title: Equiv API Value

panels.description: Your Max subscription cost prorated to the selected range. Set the price with the 'Max plan $/mo' variable.
panels.title: Plan Cost

panels.description: Peak number of sessions actively working at the same time (cmux parallelism). Sparkline shows concurrency over the range.
panels.title: Peak Agents

panels.description: Instantaneous burn rate as a multiple of the plan's equivalent hourly cost. Line turns green whenever you're beating the flat subscription.
panels.title: Leverage over time (×)
🎯 Signal vs Noise  (when burn is free, the only thing worth minimizing is wasted burn)

panels.description: Lines deleted divided by lines added. Low = clean, mostly net-new work. High = Claude rewriting its own code = thrash.
panels.title: Code Churn Ratio

panels.description: Concrete file edits produced per $100 of equivalent burn. Higher = the burn is producing code, not spinning.
panels.title: Output Density

panels.description: Equivalent dollars burned per concrete file edit. Low = dense, productive. High = lots of tokens, little shipped.
panels.title: Burn per Edit

panels.description: Per-session $ burned per edit. The session at the top burned the most for the least concrete output this range = the one to inspect.
panels.title: Burn per edit by session
Token Mix by Type (input vs cache read vs cache write)
⏱️ Burn Rate & Run-Rate (pace, not just totals)

title: Claude Code Observability
